source.statsPolicy: Exact original English stats/reminderText, including line breaks and original markup. No balancing or translated paraphrases.
source.scope: The 21 base-class Ascendancies in classes[]. Excludes alternate_ascendancies (Bloodline/Wildwood).

countDiscrepancy.resolution: Use current Default tree classes[]. Seven base classes each have three Ascendancies; overview headline is stale.

ascendancies.name: Ascendant
ascendancies.adaptationCaveat: These are multiple-choice options of class hubs, not standalone full Ascendancies. One option per connected hub; up to two class choices in a typical 8-point build.

ascendancies.name: Reliquarian
ascendancies.adaptationCaveat: These are multiple-choice options of Display hubs. Must respect armour/weapon/jewellery categories. Kaom's Roots also removes evasion; Ahn's Might changes maximum Frenzy Charges.

ascendancies.name: Luminary
ascendancies.adaptationCaveat: Requires a real Mercenary subsystem, separate from ordinary minions. Do not silently substitute spectres or generic minions for Mercenary.

ascendancies.name: Juggernaut
ascendancies.adaptationCaveat: Undeniable affects Attacks only. Untiring needs prevented Physical Hit damage history and regeneration rate, not generic healing.

ascendancies.name: Berserker
ascendancies.adaptationCaveat: Aspect of Carnage must include increased Damage taken. Instant leech requires valid leech sources. Rage is a separate resource.

ascendancies.name: Chieftain
ascendancies.adaptationCaveat: Hinekora requires kill-triggered maximum-enemy-Life explosions. Ramako only affects stationary player Damage over Time and sets resistance, rather than applying generic penetration.

ascendancies.name: Warden
ascendancies.adaptationCaveat: The current displayed class is Warden. Preserve internal Raider ID for tree linkage. Scorch/Shock/Freeze and Hoarfrost require their own ailment rules.

ascendancies.name: Deadeye
ascendancies.adaptationCaveat: Endless Munitions adds exactly 2 projectiles only to projectile skills. Ricochet requires chain targeting; Far Shot depends on actual projectile travel distance.

ascendancies.name: Pathfinder
ascendancies.adaptationCaveat: Withered and Poison are different effects. Master Toxicist requires any Flask Effect and poisoned kills. Flask charges alone do not provide active flask effects.

ascendancies.name: Occultist
ascendancies.adaptationCaveat: Profane Bloom requires cursed enemies killed by player or minions. Frigid Wake includes its timing, freeze chance, immunity and chilled-hit mitigation.

ascendancies.name: Elementalist
ascendancies.adaptationCaveat: All damage can inflict the named ailment; always inflict alone is insufficient without an ailment system. Do not retain older 3.25 numeric stats.

ascendancies.name: Necromancer
ascendancies.adaptationCaveat: Mindless Aggression is minion-only. Commander of Darkness needs aura counting for its speed line; Bone Barrier needs minion damage leech and Extra Maximum Energy Shield.

ascendancies.name: Slayer
ascendancies.adaptationCaveat: Headsman is a 20%-life execution and its attack/movement speed conditions differ. Overleech needs persistent leech instances, not unconditional regeneration.

ascendancies.name: Gladiator
ascendancies.adaptationCaveat: Bleeding, Aggravated and physical death explosions are separate mechanics. War of Attrition tracks seconds each Rare/Unique enemy has ever been in Presence, capped at 100%.

ascendancies.name: Champion
ascendancies.adaptationCaveat: Taunt, Cannot Evade and increased Damage taken must remain separate effects. Fortitude needs current maximum Fortification. Impale needs stored physical damage and hit counters.

ascendancies.name: Inquisitor
ascendancies.adaptationCaveat: Inevitable Judgement criticals ignore elemental resistance; non-critical hits penetrate 10%. Righteous Providence scales with the lower of STR/INT, not their sum.

ascendancies.name: Hierophant
ascendancies.adaptationCaveat: Arcane Blessing requires Arcane Surge; Divine Guidance includes Transfiguration of Mind and mana-before-life. Totem count bonus is not a minion count bonus.

ascendancies.name: Guardian
ascendancies.adaptationCaveat: Sentinel is a granted level-20 skill with its own stats, not a generic invulnerable summon. Time of Need is regeneration over one second each 4 seconds.

ascendancies.name: Assassin
ascendancies.adaptationCaveat: Opportunistic uses nearby Rare/Unique count. Mistwalker requires full Elusive rules. Knife in the Back and For the Jugular are mutually exclusive options of Assassination Style.

ascendancies.name: Trickster
ascendancies.adaptationCaveat: One Step Ahead is action speed, not just movement. Polymath counts distinct allocated Mastery types. Heartstopper alternates hit/DoT mitigation in exact 5-second halves.

ascendancies.name: Saboteur
ascendancies.adaptationCaveat: Bomb Specialist is a chance for more/less Area Hit damage, not a guaranteed 15% modifier. Blind requires accuracy/evasion; cooldown recovery is not direct cooldown subtraction.
